## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which Part of berth

- [ ] CLI
- [ ] Policy file / port scheme
- [ ] Ledger, claims, leases
- [ ] Reconciler / attribution
- [ ] Claude Code hooks / agent integration
- [ ] Dashboard (`berth ui`)
- [ ] Other

## Use Case

Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] I have checked `docs/DESIGN.md` and `docs/adr/`; if this changes a recorded decision (for example, berth is advisory and never blocks or kills automatically), I have said which one and why
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)
